name: dsh-skill-sidebar
description: DSH plugin (web + Desktop): a 技能 (Skills) page tab in DSH's OFFICIAL right Sidebar that lists every locally readable skill, groups them by plugin/family, and keeps new sessions cheap — only skills used in the last 30 days plus pinned ones stay in the session skill catalog, the rest become on-demand (searchable and still /invocable). Persists a cache so the list appears instantly, auto-classifies newly installed skills, and re-scans all skills every Monday.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/policy.js && node --check lib/mining.js
scripts.test: node test-policy.mjs && node test-client.mjs && node test-host.mjs && node test-desktop.mjs && node test-registry-shadow.mjs
